name: Systematic Variant Calling Pipeline Benchmark
description: A systematic benchmark that measures accuracy of state-of-the-art variant calling pipelines for coding sequence variant discovery and identifies factors affecting performance.
evaluation_method: F1 (reported with precision and recall/sensitivity and specificity breakdowns)
typical_sota_score: 90–99% (SNVs typically at the high end; indels and complex variants lower)
reputation: Respected within bioinformatics for systematic evaluation of variant calling pipelines; used in pipeline comparison studies though multiple competing benchmarks (e.g., GIAB) also exist.
notes: Performance strongly depends on sequencing technology, depth, and variant type; benchmark focuses on coding sequence, so results may not generalize to whole-genome regions; non-LLM benchmark.
